correction_hypothesis: The KSEA data-quality failure is a sparse structured-field anomaly that can be handled without value fabrication by deterministically converting every physically invalid dry-bulb temperature and its dependent relative humidity to missing across the entire frozen cohort.

transform.trigger: dry_bulb_c is non-null and outside inclusive [-60, 60] C
actions: Copy the original dry_bulb_c and relative_humidity_pct into provenance fields.
Set relative_humidity_pct to null because it is derived from the anomalous temperature/dew-point combination.
Add deterministic OUT_OF_RANGE_DRY_BULB_NULLED and DEPENDENT_RH_NULLED quality flags.
forbidden: Do not parse or substitute the METAR temperature.
Do not interpolate a replacement value.
Do not remove a station or date based on model outcome.

decision_rule.all_station_gates_pass: Freeze V2 corrected station artifacts and permit the already-preregistered confirmation runner to score all five stations once.
decision_rule.any_station_gate_fails: Do not score any station; report the confirmation experiment as blocked or failed.
